meaning:
ὀμείρομαι
(Rec. ὁμ-, see WH, App., 151), = cl. ἱμείρομαι (but prob. with different derivation, see Bl., § 6, 4; Zorell, see word) [in LXX: Job.3:21 (חָכָה)* ;]
to desire earnestly, yearn after: 1Th.2:3.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become…
